name: Modly (local AI image-to-3D desktop app)
summary: Free open-source desktop app (Windows, Linux, Apple Silicon macOS) that turns a photo into a textured 3D mesh entirely on your own GPU, using pluggable open models (Hunyuan3D 2 Mini variants, TripoSG, TRELLIS.2 GGUF). No account or credits, works offline, exports GLB/OBJ/STL/PLY; has a CLI for agents.

access.notes: App code MIT plus a clause: forks/derived apps must credit Modly in UI or docs. Each model extension keeps its own license (Hunyuan3D 2 uses Tencent's community license, not MIT); check before commercial use. Needs a capable GPU.

procedure: Download the installer from https://github.com/lightningpixel/modly/releases/latest (.exe, .AppImage or arm64 .dmg)
Launch Modly and install a model extension (Hunyuan3D 2 Mini, TripoSG or TRELLIS.2)
Drop in an image and click Generate 3D Model
Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY

verdict.why: Mature, popular (8.5k stars) local image-to-3D app with real installers for 3 OSes, no account, offline. Commercial use depends on the chosen model's license; source post is small but the project itself is well established.
